name: Pip / Indalwin Willowjayce
canonical_notes: Adult centerline anchor: sonomancy, mercy, impossible path-forging, humility, private practice, world-reading, relationship pressure, shadow-intelligence, and Unbrictionable path logic. Do not flatten into spectacle or teen branch.

name: Mack
canonical_notes: Geological father/root anchor: sacrifice, zombie/tree horror, hot ice core, 40Hz to 42Hz, world-remaking, protective/destructive momentum. Never uses human language.

name: Xethrolund / P.A.P.I.
canonical_notes: Archive/glyph anchor: blue light, diary/stasis frequency, glyph-compiled magic, quantum teaching, mind-risk, emotional denial contradicted by action.

name: Rylos / Boojay / Rylos Vayne Johnson
canonical_notes: Core collapse/love/accountability anchor. High scene value and high contamination risk. Preserve transmutation identity, Ares war-beauty, late betrayal timing, and accountability without redemption.

name: Rolzen
canonical_notes: Later-core anchor: huge body-forward love, force/boom crystal gravity-juggle combat, quick personality return, slow body healing, food/presence, Flux teaching, and Pip/Rolzen interdependence.

name: Daisy May
canonical_notes: Wordless emotional proof, route law, stasis/frozen-hand truth, and household axis. Never speaks. Never sacrificed.

name: Majiskii
canonical_notes: Sudden egg-room arrival, calm lazy unexpected power, daughter-presence, Null-is-Everything reception, and wordless family truth.

name: Neith
canonical_notes: Foundational architect villain, Rylos mother, Diamond creator/trap-maker. Do not soften early. Blood Cello pivot is genuine and complete.

name: Ursula
canonical_notes: Amethyst geode around planetary ice core, Pip's mother, cosmic maternal pressure, crystal gift, creation-song corridor. Early use subtle; later explicit cosmology.

name: Dervish
canonical_notes: Cosmic/lattice avatar and correction force. Glass-shard/ether-glass body, musical hyper-emotional glass-string voice, 'all is life' law, world-remaking support.

name: Kyreal
canonical_notes: Bipedal wolf sword-user, school benchmark strongest after Pip. Later leads Drawn search, freezes, collapses into sliced remains when Pip touches him, triggering Pip's first quantum kill-before-tears scene.

name: Vaedric Maldor Obstineth / Cockatrice
canonical_notes: Older manipulator of Rylos, altar self-blood void opener, later single ripper return, final mortal blow to Rylos. Direct intent toward Pip uncertain at first encounter.

name: Solvaenkyr / FaithFixer
canonical_notes: Refusal/wound pressure character. Intelligent wraith endpoint is rapid threshold, not gradual. Appearances test help, dependency, and refusal without shaming dependency itself.

name: Wrenath Vel'Thane Still-Water
canonical_notes: Tactile diplomacy, Eyeless/Floating City culture, Santa-hat/crown reading, archive continuity, witness to uncaptured stories.

name: Corveth Ash'Koral Dark-Current
canonical_notes: Ash-Born survival pressure and Thorn reckoning. Tactical ruthlessness plus real protective cost. Not generic villain; respect and guilt must both remain.

name: Sorra Marso'Len Thorn-Grace
canonical_notes: Adult medical ethics anchor. Productive tension with Pip; limits him for good reasons. Strong triage and returned-person authority.

name: Pethran
canonical_notes: Architecture/survivability anchor. Use with Elven/Renath to turn world-remaking into functioning civic space.

name: Feritha
canonical_notes: Cross-faction adult intake/medical authority. Field execution counterpart to Sorra's ethical policy pressure.

name: Caera
canonical_notes: Off-ledger negotiator. Morally tense but not corrupt by default. Use for impossible resources and ethically risky channels.

name: Ferryman Calix the Grey
canonical_notes: Near-core encounter utility: uncrossable routes, truth-price, threshold law, death/rebirth, desert/gate crossings.

name: Healer Thresh Nightbloom
canonical_notes: Veil-Walker medicine, dimensional wounds, hard to find/worth finding. Use where normal medicine cannot reach.

name: The Drawn
canonical_notes: Devious but not malicious by default. Feature swaps/dimensional activations have lasting bodily/social consequence.

name: Pethran / Elven / Renath
canonical_notes: Worldbirth architecture, agriculture, food security, supply chains, and non-spectacular survival competence.

name: Ithren / Keeper Olvath
canonical_notes: Ithren keeps living memory of sonomancy; Olvath keeps documented artifacts. Use disagreement between living memory and written record productively.

name: High Warden Drest / Accord Chair Peln
canonical_notes: Faction governance, survival math, guilt, apology limits, and council pressure.

name: Alex
canonical_notes: Entrusts Daisy May and Majiskii. Do not overextend; the entrustment is the whole function.

name: Merchant Lassith / Vault Keeper Derris / Broker Teth
canonical_notes: Markets, vault access, prices that are not money, resource brokerage, and threshold cost.

name: Kyrel / Aenwyn / Daevyn / Selwyn
canonical_notes: Youth-cohort pressure: brave-wrong action, physical care, emotional aftermath, growth without shaming dependency.
